thread:
Maya (Support): Customer (ACME) reported 403 immediately after upgrading plan from dev -> pro. UI shows 'Invalid API key' but logs show entitlement check failed. Case #12345. Can someone triage?
Jon (Eng): Can you paste the failing request headers/body (redact keys)? Is this via SSO token or API key?
Maya (Support): They call the hosted API with a bearer token (SSO session exchange). Header: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `X-Tenant-ID: acme-corp`. Payload standard. Response body snippet: `{ "error": "403", "message": "access denied", "code": "plan_entitlement_missing" }`. UI maps that to invalid key which confused the customer.
Priya (SRE): That mapping is known UX smell but important: service returns plan gating 403 and frontend interprets as auth fail. More worrying — entitlement service returned false right after billing upgrade, likely cache/stale. Can we repro?
Maya (Support): I reproduced from my laptop. Curl: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "X-Tenant-ID: acme-corp" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate``` Response: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "plan_entitlement_missing", "details": "no active sku for tenant" }```
Jon (Eng): Thanks. We changed the billing webhook target two weeks ago (billing-prod -> billing-v2). Looks like the entitlement cache invalidation hook was pointing at the old endpoint. If subscription updated but webhook didn't reach entitlements, tenant stays flagged.
Priya (SRE): I can force a manual sync for the tenant: `POST /internal/entitlements/sync?tenant=acme-corp` — that'll pull billing state and invalidate caches. Doing it now.
deploy-bot: runbook triggered by Priya: entitlement-sync (runbook#213). Start time 2024-11-07T15:12:05Z.
Priya (SRE): Sync completed. Retried the curl, now 200 and tokens work. Logging shows previous webhook attempts failed with 404 -> old path.
Jon (Eng): Root cause confirmed: webhook routing change + no backwards-compatible proxy caused missed entitlement update. Also frontend maps plan-gate 403 to invalid-key message — we should change wording to 'account plan prevents this action' to avoid confusion.
Carlos (CSE): I pinged the customer, applied workaround (manual sync) and restarted their session. They were fine once entitlement updated. Customer asked for timeline on permanent fix.
Jon (Eng): I'll open a PR to (1) add fallback webhook proxy for old path (2) ensure billing webhooks surface delivery failures in billing dashboard (3) change frontend mapping of that 403 to clearer text.
Maya (Support): Repro steps for internal docs: 1) Customer upgrades plan via billing UI. 2) If billing webhook fails to reach entitlements -> API returns 403 with code plan_entitlement_missing. 3) Workaround: run internal sync endpoint or admin console 'sync tenant'. 4) Notify customer to retry after sync. Include correlation id from support logs.
Jon (Eng): Estimate: proxy + alerting ~1d, frontend message ~2-3 hours. Will assign JIRA and tag eng-oncall.
Priya (SRE): Adding automated test: deliver a simulated billing webhook and assert entitlement flips within TTL. Also add alert if webhook failure rate > 0.5%/hour.
Maya (Support): Customer notified and case updated — marking as mitigated. Will keep open until PR merges. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Carlos (CSE): Customer appreciated the quick manual fix. Requested a short blurb we can send to their security team explaining no keys were compromised (this was entitlement-only).
Jon (Eng): Will draft note and share in thread.
Maya (Support): Closing loop once PR merged.
